note: GA-139 (the mountains along the bottom of the window): the band's tokens for design/tokens.json, in its format. The frontend card adds band-line and band-glow, with the pair of the strength Jefsev picked (and points them at it), to color.tokens after scrim, and the sizes to size.tokens after size-statusbar, then runs node scripts/tokens-css.ts. Made by gen-bottom-band.mjs.

tokens.name: band-subtle-line
tokens.usage: Subtle: the lines (currentColor of the band's SVG).

tokens.name: band-subtle-glow
tokens.usage: Subtle: the glow at the bottom edge, fading to nothing at the band's top.

tokens.name: band-medium-line
tokens.usage: Medium: the lines (currentColor of the band's SVG).

tokens.name: band-medium-glow
tokens.usage: Medium: the glow at the bottom edge, fading to nothing at the band's top.

tokens.name: band-strong-line
tokens.usage: Strong: the lines (currentColor of the band's SVG).

tokens.name: band-strong-glow
tokens.usage: Strong: the glow at the bottom edge, fading to nothing at the band's top.

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: The band's lines: the strength Jefsev picks (the proposal until then).

tokens.name: band-glow
tokens.usage: The band's glow: the strength Jefsev picks.

tokens.name: size-band
tokens.usage: The band's height in a window 915px high or more; lower windows get 14% of their height (clamp(size-band-min, 14vh, size-band)).

tokens.name: size-band-min
tokens.usage: The band's least height; under 560px of window height the band goes.
